questions.question:
**Given below are four sentences in jumbled order. Select the option that gives their correct order.**

A. On coming out, his skin would be shining like ebony and he would squeal with pleasure.

B. First, he would lie down on the sand bank while I rubbed him clean with the sand of the river.

C. Every day, I used to take the baby elephant to the river for his bath.

D. After that, he would lie in the water for a long time.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is '**CBDA**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The given question is an example of a Para Jumble.
 
• We know that the first statement of a para jumbled question is usually an independent general statement, a noun, a universal fact, starting off a story, starting of an incident or an event, or it starts with 'most' or 'once'.
 
• Sentence C in the given question is the starting of a story. The author is saying that he used to take the baby elephant to the river for a bath.
 
• Sentence B will be the next sentence because it is connected with Sentence C as it tells what the elephant used to do before bathing.
 
• Sentence D will be the next sentence because it further explains Sentence B.
 
• Lastly, Sentence A will be used.
 
• Thus, the sequence becomes:
 
 
• C: Every day, I used to take the baby elephant to the river for his bath.
 
• B: First, he would lie down on the sand bank while I rubbed him clean with the sand of the river.
 
• D: After that, he would lie in the water for a long time.
 
• A: On coming out, his skin would be shining like ebony and he would squeal with pleasure.
 
 
 
• Therefore, as per the points mentioned above, we find that the correct answer is Option 2.

Correct Sequence:__ *Every day, I used to take the baby elephant to the river for his bath. First, he would lie down on the sand bank while I rubbed him clean with the sand of the river. After that, he would lie in the water for a long time. On coming out, his skin would be shining like ebony and he would squeal with pleasure.*

questions.question:
**Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the right order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.**

A. On the other, there is the principle of leadership.

B. Democracy rests on a tension between two different principles.

C. While the first gives priority to rules, the second gives importance to persons.

D. On the one hand, there is the principle of equality before the law, or more generally, equality.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **'BDAC'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given question is an example of a Para Jumble.
 
• We know that the first statement of a para jumbled question is usually an independent general statement, a noun, a universal fact, starting off a story, starting of an incident or an event, or it starts with 'most' or 'once'.
 
• Sentence B will be the first statement because it is** a general independent statement. **The author is talking about Democracy.
 
• Sentence D will be the next sentence because it is talking about the first principle which is being discussed in **Sentence B.**
 
• Sentence A will be the next sentence because it is talking about the second principle.
 
• Lastly, Sentence C will be used because it is talking about both the principles that have been discussed earlier.
 
• Thus, the sequence becomes:
 
 
• B: Democracy rests on a tension between two different principles.
 
• D: On the one hand, there is the principle of equality before the law, or more generally, equality.
 
• A: On the other, there is the principle of leadership.
 
• C: While the first gives priority to rules, the second gives importance to persons.
 
 
 
• Therefore, as per the points mentioned above, we find that the correct answer is Option 3.

Correct Sequence:__ *Democracy rests on a tension between two different principles. On the one hand, there is the principle of equality before the law, or more generally, equality. On the other, there is the principle of leadership. While the first gives priority to rules, the second gives importance to persons.*

questions.question:
**The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.**

All our / furnitures were / spoiled in the recent / rains and floods.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is** 'furnitures were'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is grammatically incorrect. 
 
• Here,** 'furniture was' **should be used instead of** 'furnitures were'.**
 
• The plural form of '**furniture**' is not '**furnitures**'. Hence, the given sentence is grammatically incorrect. 
 
• **Furniture** is an uncountable noun and is not used in the plural. It is also not used with the plural verb hence, we need to use "Furniture was"
 
 
• *Example: The house has some beautiful old **furniture**.*
 
 
 
• Therefore, as per the points mentioned above, we find that the correct answer is** Option 3.**

 

**Correct Sentence:__** *All our furniture was spoiled in the recent rains and floods.* 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **__Hinglish__**

 
• दिया गया वाक्य व्याकरण की दृष्टि से गलत है।
 
• यहाँ **'furnitures were' **के स्थान पर** 'furniture were' **का प्रयोग किया जाना चाहिए।
 
• '**Furniture**' का बहुवचन रूप '**Furnitures**' नहीं है। अतः दिया गया वाक्य व्याकरण की दृष्टि से गलत है।

__
 
• The given sentence is in Direct Speech. As per the question, we have to change it into Indirect Speech. 
 
• The process of transformation is as follows:
 
 
• In the given sentence the reporting verb has an object. Hence, 'said to' will be changed into '**asked**'. 
 
• Comma and inverted commas will be removed. 
 
• The conjunction 'if' will be added.
 
• '**you**' will be changed into '**she**' because the **second person pronoun** is changed according to the **object** of** the reporting verb.**
 
• '**my**' will be changed into '**her**' because **the first person pronoun** is changed according to the **subject** of** the reporting verb.**
 
• '**will**' will be changed into '**would**'. 
 
 
 
• Therefore, as per the points mentioned above, we find that the correct answer is Option 4.

• Comma and inverted commas हटा दिए जाएंगे।
 
• संयोजन 'if' जोड़ा जाएगा।
 
• 'you' को 'she' में बदल दिया जाएगा क्योंकि second person pronoun reporting verb की object के अनुसार बदल जाता है।
 
• '**my**' को '**her**' में बदल दिया जाएगा क्योंकि first person pronoun reporting verb के subject के अनुसार बदल दिया गया है।
 
• '**will**' को '**would**' में बदल दिया जाएगा।
